subject.title: fix(hooks): restore --exclude-labels in Gmail watcher args

question: Should this PR land a new public `hooks.gmail.excludeLabels` config surface, or be narrowed to restoring the shipped default excluded labels only?
rationale: OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces, and the core regression can be fixed without adding a new operator-facing knob; accepting the knob also requires deciding the empty-list contract.

options.title: Narrow To Default Restore
options.body: Remove the new config/docs/schema surface and restore only the default `--exclude-labels SPAM,TRASH,DRAFT,SENT` behavior with focused tests and proof.

options.title: Accept Config With Correct Semantics
options.body: Keep `hooks.gmail.excludeLabels`, but require explicit empty-string forwarding, aligned docs/schema/tests, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause Or Replace Branch
options.body: If refreshing this old branch through newer Gmail argv work is too costly, keep the linked issue open and land a narrow replacement PR instead.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Default Restore
recommendation.body: Remove the new config/docs/schema surface and restore only the default `--exclude-labels SPAM,TRASH,DRAFT,SENT` behavior with focused tests and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Gmail hooks helper surface and is the strongest history-backed owner for deciding whether this new config knob belongs in core.
